confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of London price levels and July peak-season demand; no live listings or current price pages were checked. Restaurant, cafe and drink anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain given wide variation by district and date. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly, not derived from beer. The FX observation comes from web search summaries of RBA pages, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; estimated directly for London as a high-cost Western European capital with strong July tourism demand.
